review_candidates.description: MEC Overview We believe the transformative power of the outdoors makes us better humans and drives us to do good for the planet. We are here to inspire and support everyone in getting active outside, matching people with gear and advice that instills confidence. We offer more than products, we offer passion. People connect here, through our stores, online channels, over the phone, or through our services and community partners. We love to share our expertise, experience, and enthusiasm. We deliver award winning retail experiences, encourage an entrepreneurial spirit and believe the outdoors make us better. Our business model is dependent on impassioned and well-trained outdoor enthusiasts and as such we look for individuals who live our purpose and fit with MEC ethos and lifestyle. If you are that person, we’d love to connect with you! MEC offers a total rewards package that includes a great base pay, a sweet employee discount, a comprehensive benefit package, matching RRSP contributions, an employee development program that even lets you try out gear for yourself, self-directed and leader-based training, and a host of other perks and advantages tailored to those who love the outdoors. MEC is an equal opportunity employer. We’re proud to work with our people to create a diverse workplace, which accommodates individuals of all abilities, backgrounds and identities. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Tell us what you need during the hiring process, and we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Job Overview This role supports MEC’s success by ensuring Visual Presentation standards align with MEC strategy and offers exceptional customer experience. Responsibilities and Duties Ensures all visual elements are displayed with current merchandise and reflect current market trends. Implements the setup of all promotional set ups and seasonal changeovers. Performs daily maintenance floor checks. Prepares store displays, mannequins & bust forms dressing & styling according to MEC standards and best practices. Prepares table merchandising and vignettes. Plans and organizes the merchandising of walls and floor fixtures. Provides member service according to SERVE standard . Adjusts lighting to highlight mannequins and merchandise. Communicates Visual standards and provides training to other floor staff. Liaises with Department Managers on departments and promotional set ups. Adheres to all loss prevention policies and procedures. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications 1-3 years of previous Visual Display and merchandising experience. Exceptional planning, organization and time management skills. Ability to think commercially and adhere to corporate standards. Ability to understand our members needs and translate that into display. High attention to detail and passion for creative ideas. Great time management skills and ability to execute multiple tasks and appropriately manage competing priorities. Ability to independently lead self to achieve results. Strong problem solver and innovative. Ability to work a flexible schedule that meets the business needs. Self-motivated, deadline driven, works well under pressure. Positive upbeat can do attitude. Ability to work in a team setting and contribute to stores success. Physical Requirements A degree of physical fitness for manual shifting of mannequins and fixtures. Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods of time. Continually able to lift up to 40 pounds from floor to a waist high table. Comfortable climbing ladders. Compensation This role ranges from $20.40 to $23.00 per hour, depending on skills, experience, and certifications.

review_candidates.title: Vice President, Sales & Business Development
review_candidates.description: Most senior sales roles come with a fixed product, a territory and a number. This one comes with a portfolio of proven technology, customers who already rely on it, and the freedom to decide what to build next in your region. The role has two parts: Build. Find the customer problems our technology can solve, shape new propositions with our product and engineering teams, and prove them through demonstrations and pilots Win. Personally lead and close the deals that turn those propositions into revenue, then make them repeatable You will not start from a blank canvas. We are looking for a seasoned enterprise hunter who already knows the buyers in their region and can open doors from day one. As your region grows, so does your remit: you will build the team, partners and plan to take it to the next stage. Why this role is different Room to create. You are not limited to a price list. Good ideas get product and engineering support, and you will work directly with the CEO and a small leadership team that makes decisions quickly A strong starting position. Mission-critical software already running inside operators, and a digital experience testing platform used by enterprise engineering teams, give you multiple ways into a customer Real support. BDR, marketing, pre-sales, solutions and global delivery teams behind you, with operations that are stable and well run Upside that matches the ambition. Competitive base salary plus variable pay weighted to new business you originate and close. Our technology portfolio Our product lines span telecoms service activation and provisioning, SIM and number management, subscriber acquisition and dealer management, customer value management and loyalty, alongside digital experience testing and analytics for mobile, web and streaming applications, including real-device testing, test automation and quality-of-experience analytics. Together they let you enter a customer through one need, such as activation, loyalty or app quality, and build towards a broader relationship. Where you will play Telecommunications. Mobile and fixed operators and MVNOs Banking and financial services. Retail and digital banks, payment providers and fintechs with business-critical digital journeys Media and entertainment. Broadcasters, streaming and OTT video and audio services Global technology and digital platforms. Large internet and platform businesses with demanding product and digital experience needs Depth in one of these sectors matters more than coverage of all four. Regions and languages Asia including China: business-fluent English and Mandarin essential, including leading discovery and negotiation in Mandarin. Other Asian languages advantageous. Requirements Find the opportunities. Build executive relationships through outreach, industry insight, referrals and partners. Spot unmet needs and buying initiatives before they become tenders Shape the propositions. With Product, Engineering and Delivery, turn customer insight into offers with a clear use case, pricing, business case and route to market. Test demand and economics before committing resources Prove them. Run demonstrations, pilots and proofs of concept with agreed success criteria and a clear path to a contract Close the business. Own complex enterprise pursuits from qualification through procurement, negotiation and signature Expand and partner. Grow from the first product line into others across the customer, and build a focused group of systems integrators, testing service providers and technology partners with joint target accounts Build the region. Own the regional plan, pipeline and forecast, and work with Finance on revenue, margin and investment. Recommend and hire the team as demand justifies it What Success Looks Like First 90 days: senior conversations opened with priority accounts from your existing network, a focused regional plan, agreed targets and a credible qualified pipeline By six months: first signed business, at least one proposition validated with customers, and evidence of which offers and channels win repeatedly By twelve months: bookings and revenue on target, multiple new customers, a strong forward pipeline and a plan for the region's next stage What You Bring 10+ years of enterprise sales hunting. At least ten years selling B2B technology to large enterprises, with a consistent record of personally originating and closing complex new-logo contracts and beating targets Something you built. Experience taking a technology-led proposition from customer need through launch to paying customers Established relationships in your region. Named, active relationships with senior decision-makers at operators, banks, media or platform companies in your territory, and with the systems integrators and partners who influence them. A working knowledge of local procurement and competition Sector depth. Success in telecoms, financial services, media or major technology platforms Commercial and technical fluency. Value-based selling, business cases, pricing and margin, and the credibility to work with product and engineering leaders Ownership. Entrepreneurial, persistent and able to mobilise colleagues who do not report to you. The regional language skills above are essential You will stand out if you have founded or launched a business line, built a team, or opened a new market for a technology company. Benefits Competitive base salary and variable pay tied to new business The freedom to shape the market approach and propositions for your region Direct access to the CEO and leadership team, and the backing of established product, delivery and support teams A remit that grows with the business you build

review_candidates.title: Value for Money Manager
review_candidates.description: Help Shape the UK’s Energy Future Value for Money Manager Opportunity with the Civil Works Alliance (CWA), Supporting Sizewell C As part of the CWA (Civil Works Alliance), you will support the building of Sizewell C. Sizewell C will be a 3.2-gigawatt power station generating low-carbon electricity for around 6 million homes and will play a key role in our energy future, supplying reliable, clean electricity for at least 60 years. This role will be within the CWA Wide Section. What will you do? Value for Money Manager The CWA is seeking an experienced Value for Money Manager to join as an embedded specialist within the Civil Works Alliance. This is a central control role designed to institutionalise the Alliance's core proposition for Target Outturn Cost (TOC) development, risk and opportunity ownership, Project Alliance Agreement (PAA) obligation delivery, and RAB-compliant Value for Money (VfM) evidence. The successful candidate will ensure the CWA protects the Sizewell C Integrated Works Schedule baseline cost and programme performance through a disciplined, auditable and continuously improving operating system. What You Will Do • Embed and institutionalise the CWA core proposition, ensuring TOC development and gate-by-gate progress of risk ownership, PAA obligation delivery and RAB-compliant VfM evidence are readily available and demonstrable. • Own the system, process, method, evidence standard and continuous improvement framework within the CWA for PAA, RAB, VfM, risk and opportunity integration. • Establish a disciplined and auditable process that enables consistent challenge, evidence sufficiency and delivery accountability. • Drive continual improvement in the maturity, traceability and defensibility of TOC development and approval processes. • Challenge TOC assumptions and require evidence, maturity, named ownership and traceability for material assumptions. • Ensure that no material risk enters the TOC unless it is traceable to cost, schedule, owner, treatment and supporting evidence. • Escalate weak VfM positions and evidence gaps that threaten NTS/NTP acceptance or RAB defensibility. • Recommend that gate progression is held where evidence is insufficient, double-counted, weakly owned or not delivery-ready. • Ensure that residual risk is formally accepted by Delivery Directors at each relevant gate. • Work closely with the CWA Alliance Director, TOC Director, Bid Director, TOC Team and Delivery Directors to ensure clear accountability. • Support Delivery Directors in taking ownership of delivery assumptions, risk acceptance, logistics readiness and workface readiness. • Promote the integrated ownership of planning, logistics and industrialisation across CWP, SD and CWA. • Ensure that value is protected after NTP through leakage identification, reporting and action tracking. • Implement post-NTP controls to monitor VfM leakage, risk crystallisation, opportunity realisation and TOC drift. • Establish learning loops, root cause analysis and improvement actions to enhance subsequent TOC development and delivery performance. • Define and maintain evidence standards required to pass LOD-0, LOD-1, LOD-2 and LOD-3 scrutiny. • Support delivery teams in evidencing workface readiness, methodology, constraints, logistics demand, risk treatment and PAA/RAB/VfM compliance. • Support the progressive assurance model by strengthening the quality of CWA self-evidence at LOD-0 What are we looking for? Degree qualification in a relevant discipline such as Engineering, Commercial Management, Construction Management, Risk Management, Economics or Programme Management Significant experience in nuclear, major infrastructure, regulated utilities, transport or other highly regulated sectors Experience in major commercial programme, risk, assurance, delivery or TOC leadership roles gained across alliance networks, regulated infrastructure operators, major capital programmes or specialist commercial/risk consultancies Senior delivery leadership experience in high-value, high-complexity infrastructure programmes with proven influencing skills, including the ability to challenge senior leaders and Delivery Directors constructively with evidence Proven track record of implementing or strengthening governance, evidence and assurance disciplines across live delivery packages Experience in risk and opportunity quantification and in establishing traceability between risks, assumptions and programme outcomes Strong understanding of TOC development, target cost processes, PAA compliance, RAB principles and Value for Money requirements Ability to integrate cost, schedule, risk, opportunity and commercial evidence into a single decision-making framework Ability to establish and operate auditable, evidence-led governance and assurance processes in complex programme environments Strong analytical capability in relation to delivery readiness, evidence sufficiency, post-NTP value protection and performance assurance Demonstrated capability in risk and opportunity integration, including traceability to cost, schedule, ownership and treatment Strong ability to challenge assumptions, detect weak evidence, identify double counting and escalate material concerns appropriately Excellent communication, facilitation and reporting skills with strong commercial judgement Committed to Best-for-Project outcomes and ability to translate compliance and governance requirements into practical embedded delivery controls Experience in alliance contracting, target outturn cost (TOC) environments or comparable collaborative delivery models (desirable) Working experience in regulated infrastructure environments with RAB, economic regulation or consumer-defensibility considerations (desirable) Familiarity with LOD-based assurance and progressive evidence models (desirable) Experience supporting NTS/NTP or equivalent gate approval processes (desirable) Experience of post-approval delivery control, leakage tracking and value protection frameworks (desirable) What we will offer you? The CWA is a single delivery organisation made of up of the client (Sizewell C) and three parent companies - Balfour Beatty, Bouygues and Laing O'Rourke - which offer industry leading packages including market leading salaries, generous annual leave entitlements, pension scheme and other flexible benefits. About Us The CWA celebrates the creativity and innovation that comes from a diverse workforce, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds — especially those from under‑represented communities. Our project is built on five core values: Humility, Positivity, Respect, Solidarity, and Clarity. By joining us, you’ll be encouraged to bring your whole self to work, speak up, and share your ideas. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of gender, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. We are committed to protecting your privacy. If you decide to apply, please avoid including sensitive personal data in your CV.

review_candidates.title: Trade Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Equinorth Capital is a dynamic financial services firm committed to facilitating seamless trade and investment flows. We provide tailored financial solutions that empower businesses to expand their operations locally and internationally. We are currently seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Trade Specialist to join our team and manage the end-to-end execution of our trade finance operations. Role Summary The Trade Specialist will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of trade transactions, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and facilitating both import and export operations. The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of Nigerian trade regulations, documentary collections, and international banking practices. You will serve as the bridge between our clients, banks, and regulatory bodies to ensure efficient and profitable trade execution. Key Responsibilities 1.⁠ ⁠Trade Finance & Banking Operations LC Issuance & Management: Manage the end-to-end process of Letters of Credit (LCs) including application, issuance, amendments, and negotiation of documents. Documentary Collections: Handle Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) ensuring strict compliance with UCP 600 rules. Bank Instruments: Facilitate the issuance of Bank Guarantees, Advance Payment Guarantees, and Standby Letters of Credit. Financing: Coordinate trade financing facilities (e.g., Pre-export finance, Import finance, Invoice discounting) with banking partners. 2.⁠ ⁠Export Operations (Expanded) NXP & Form Management: Expertly handle the processing of Nigerian Export Proceeds (NXP) forms, ensuring accurate completion and submission on the Nigeria Single Window for Trade (NSW). Regulatory Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to CBN (Central Bank of Nigeria) circulars regarding export proceeds, repatriation timelines, and documentation. Shipping & Logistics Documentation: Review and manage Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, and quality certificates to ensure they meet international standards and LC terms. Export Incentives: Advise on and process claims for export incentives (e.g., RT200, NESS) where applicable. 3.⁠ ⁠Import Operations Form M & PAAR: Oversee the opening of Form M and ensure the timely processing of Pre-Arrival Assessment Reports (PAAR). Customs & Clearing: Liaise with customs agents and freight forwarders to ensure smooth clearance of goods and resolve any bottlenecks. Duty Management: Verify HS codes and ensure accurate duty calculations to prevent delays. 4.⁠ ⁠Compliance, Risk & Relationship Management KYC/AML: Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks on counterparties and clients. Regulatory Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact with commercial banks, the CBN, and the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS). Risk Mitigation: Identify potential discrepancies in trade documents before presentation to banks to avoid delays or financial loss. Client Advisory: Provide expert advice to internal teams and clients on trade regulations, documentation requirements, and market trends. Requirements & Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field. Experience: Minimum of [3-5] years of proven experience in Trade Finance, specifically within a bank, financial institution, or trading company in Nigeria. Technical Expertise: Mandatory experience with NXP (Nigerian Export Proceeds) and Form M. Proficiency in LC issuance, amendments, and document checking. Strong understanding of UCP 600, URC 522, and ISP98. Experience with the Nigeria Single Window (NSW) and Trade Monitoring System (TRMS). Skills: Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Why Join Equinorth Capital? Opportunity to work with a forward-thinking team in the financial sector. Competitive salary and performance-based incentives. Professional development and growth opportunities.

Requisitos del Cargo • Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería en Construcción o carrera afín. • Deseable postítulo en PMO, Planificación y Control de Proyectos. • Mínimo 10 años de experiencia en planificación de proyectos de inversión superiores a USD 100 millones o carteras de similar magnitud. • Experiencia en proyectos con múltiples frentes de trabajo simultáneos y programas de ejecución diferenciados. • Experiencia liderando equipos y/o administrando servicios de terceros. • Experiencia en gestión e influencia de stakeholders, contratistas y empresas de ingeniería y construcción. • Disponibilidad para trabajar en terreno. • Inglés deseable. Competencias Clave • Capacidad de influencia • Gestión estratégica de stakeholders • Comunicación efectiva • Capacidad analítica y visión sistémica • Autonomía y toma de decisiones Entorno de trabajo Cargo con base en Santiago, régimen 5x2, dentro del equipo de Control de Proyecto. A medida que avance la construcción, la modalidad evolucionará hacia una mayor presencia en terreno. En Capstone Copper promovemos un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso, donde valoramos las distintas miradas, experiencias y trayectorias. Creemos que la diversidad fortalece nuestras decisiones y el desempeño de nuestros equipos, y fomentamos la igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas. Postula con nosotros desde el 04 al 25 de noviembre. ¡Te esperamos! The Senior Human Resources Generalist serves as deputy to the Director of Human Resources and is the primary resource for managers and supervisors on employee relations. This position handles most day-to-day manager guidance and coaching, manages performance, attendance, and conduct issues; conducts routine investigations, and interprets the collective bargaining agreement.
